checks: A compact Postgres event updates power, temperature, mode, fan, Turbo and receiver capabilities across six engines immediately, with zero database fetches or writes.
Private Broadcast and Postgres delivery of the same observation produce one update per page.
Private Broadcast updates the UI directly without waiting for the fallback polling timer.
Delayed older OFF events cannot overwrite a newer ON observation.
A heartbeat refreshes connection indicators while preserving the original IR observation timestamp.
The production dashboard DOM changes to Remote OFF, received temperature and independent Turbo on the fast event.
An in-flight stale database response cannot roll back a newer received observation.
A fresh database recovery read still detects offline hardware.
A connection-only nodes heartbeat does not refetch the registry.
An unknown controller event schedules reconciliation without creating a profile or controller.
The production scheduler immediately follows received power, target temperature, mode, fan and Turbo without fetching database records.
Fast schedule updates preserve unsaved wake/sleep times and report interval inputs.
A fresh repeated physical setting overrides a newer requested UI setting; equality of decoded values does not suppress it.
The delivered receiver sketch attempts a compact decoded observation before scheduled heartbeat polling and enables HTTP keep-alive.
